description: Daily high and low temperature for a US weather station from NWS: running provisional high/low over the station's climate day (midnight-midnight local standard time) and the official NWS Daily Climate Report (CLI) high/low once issued, flagged preliminary or final. Useful for temperature settlement, weather prediction markets and climate records. Optional temperature buckets (width/offset or explicit edges). Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.01 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/weather/climate-day.

cli.description: override CLI location code (default: station without leading K)

date.description: climate date (LST), default today; up to ~6 days back

edges.description: comma-separated increasing bucket edges; overrides width/offset

station.description: NWS/ICAO station id, e.g. KNYC, KMDW, KLAX

name: climate_day
title: NWS climate-day high/low + official CLI
